prompt: a breakbeat piece built on the sliced demo loop, showing every way the sample part can cut it

requests.ask: make a much more interesting example song

changes.why: the loop as recorded, eight equal slices, filtered and far off so the break is the whole arrangement
halves: bar two swaps for a repeat of bar one every other pass, and the square bass enters on the octave leap
the trimmed second bar only (begin .5) quartered, at its own bpm 99 so the break drops in pitch and gets heavy
quarters with one step doubled and the last alternating; fx riser into the climax and the marimba answers undertow's question
break points isolating the first kick and the first snare, played syncopated with stretch so the long slice is squeezed; piano hook, glockenspiel counter-line, impact on the downbeat
the same eight slices with all but two deleted, space .9: the tide out

requests.ask: review: the climax chop isolates two kicks and no snare, and stretch transposes the slices wildly

changes.why: break points .0625 .125 .1875 .25 .5 so slice 0 is the first kick and slice 2 the first snare (the decoded loop puts a snare at .125, not at .5); the pattern now plays kick on one, snare on two, snare and kick on the backbeat
every hit sits on an eighth-of-a-bar step and the half-bar slice on a half-bar step, so stretch locks the fit instead of transposing: every event is at the natural speed 0.275
the phrase now ends on the fifth (5@2) rather than degree 2, so the question the surge answers is a real half-cadence
VI VII i instead of repeating swell's i VI, so the release has its own harmonic move home

requests.ask: review: undertow's line ends on degree 5, which is the sixth, not the fifth

changes.why: the phrase ends on degree 4 (the fifth) instead of 5 (the sixth): '0 ~ 3 ~ 2 ~ 0@2 ~ 3 ~ 4 ~ 7 4@2', an open half cadence that surge's line answers on the root

requests.ask: add a -mixed version of arc, arrival, breakwater, cutwork, hunted and machine without altering the originals

changes.why: size 1.1 fade .3 damping 6000: one short room for a breakbeat, each part's space as its send
the drums layer was the mix (0.8 dB under it, 5% of samples clipping) over a loop that is the real kit; now 3 under, next to the break at 4
the bass was 6.5 dB under the mix; under the kick, ducked with a written recovery
the piano hook was 21 dB under the mix; now 11, foreground, a little right with a velocity line
glockenspiel>vibraphone the bell twin measured 57 dB under the mix (inaudible); a vibraphone at register .7 sits at 19, set left
wide, behind, a little left, lightly ducked
the impact set back

requests.ask: use the new mixing tools on the -mixed songs: impulse-response rooms, humanize, compressor, depth words

changes.why: synthetic>room the generated small room (0.9 s, 8 ms pre-delay) keeps the break's attacks in front of the reverb
the marimba and piano played (12 ms, phrase-correlated)
closer: weight up (.58)
farther: darker (.38), lighter (.42)
